biome_source._comment: Voronoi picks nearest seed; *_min_radius fields then floor the tier so we guarantee an easy core. floor_jitter perturbs both floors via low-frequency value noise so the easy/medium boundary is wavy rather than a circle (effective radius ranges roughly [base-jitter, base+jitter]). Seed radii are deliberately spread across [1700, 4700] — easy core anchored at origin, medium seeds mostly at r ≈ 1700–2500 with two outer pockets near r ≈ 4000, hard seeds mostly at r ≈ 3700–4700 with two inner intrusions near r ≈ 3000. Net result: bias toward easy near spawn and hard at the edges, but the rings aren't concentric and same-radius cells can land in different tiers.
